property_summary: For any uint x, calling SetMinSum(x) on a fresh (not initialized) reference contract succeeds and sets MinSum to x; the mutant inverts the initialization guard causing SetMinSum to revert (and thus MinSum not updated) for those same inputs.
change_summary: Change the guard from reverting when already initialized to allowing SetMinSum only if initialized (inverts the condition and reverts otherwise), which alters whether MinSum is updated after calls to SetMinSum.
